messages.text: Before we start, roll my Strength. Roll 4d6 and drop the lowest.
I swing my boathook at the toll-keeper's dog. I have advantage and +5 to hit. Roll it.
I climb the sea wall in the fog. In this game we roll three d20s and each 11 or higher is a success. The fog imposes a burden die. Roll it and tell me how many successes I got.
I try it again with the rope, which gives me two advantage dice instead. Same rules. How many successes?

/roll 3d20b Does the rope hold?
Same rules. How many successes did I get on that?

/roll d20a - d20b Opposed check
That's my d20 with advantage against the toll-keeper's d20 with a burden. What did each of us roll, and who won?
My alchemist's fire crits the toll-keeper. Roll 2d6+3 and double the whole thing.
